fee_notes: Royalty is 4.5% of total Gross Sales, billed weekly and due 16 days after invoice date. Royalty may be reduced or eliminated under certain programs (Purchase Program, Single Store Development Program, Multi-Store Development Program) depending on sales volume and negotiated terms; also subject to temporary reduction under Development Incentive Program. National Advertising Fee is 3.5% of Gross Sales pooled with all U.S. franchisees. No required Local Advertising Fee currently. Cooperative Advertising is optional and variable. Technology Help Desk (Dine Brands) is $1,000-$1,800/year (optional but highly recommended); Self-Supported Technology Support is $275-$400/service incident. Punchh/loyalty and BYOD/Pay 'N' Go fees are $0-$100 paid indirectly through National Advertising Fund contributions. Implementation fees $250-$1,500. National Gift Card Program charge is 15% of redeemed portion of gift cards sold in national program. On-Location Assistance Fee $0-$16,000 (optional). Renewal Fee $10,000 for General Renewal Term. Transfer Fee (Franchise Agreement) $7,500 plus $5,000 training fee per person per Restaurant. Transfer Fee (Multi-Store Development Agreement) $2,500. Additional Training Fee $5,000/person/Restaurant. Additional Assistance Fee $375/day/person plus expenses. Delayed Approval Fee $170/day; Delayed Development Fee $350/day. Compliance Audit Fee: interest at highest rate allowed by law plus cost of audit if understatement >=2% of Gross Sales. Food Safety Evaluation Reaudit Fee $0-$1,280; Egg Audit $0-$500.
raw_excerpt:
Type of Fee 1 Amount Due Date Remarks
Royalty 4.5% of total Gross Sales Billed weekly and due 16 days after invoice date Gross Sales is defined in footnote 2 of this Item 6.
National Advertising Fee 3.5% of total Gross Sales Same as Royalty Fee We pool these funds with payments from all U.S. franchisees.
Local Advertising Fee There is currently no required local advertising fee Same as Royalty Fee There is currently not a Local Advertising Fee.
Cooperative Advertising Varies depending on your decision to participate Same as Royalty Fee This fee is optional.
Additional Training Fee $5,000 per person per Restaurant Prior to training Payable if your manager is replaced, requiring the new manager to complete Initial Training
Additional Assistance Fee $375 per day per person, plus reasonable transportation and living expenses Upon demand Payable if you request additional assistance from IHOP's or an IHOP Affiliate's training staff or if IHOP requires if you do not have an approved manager.
Compliance Audit Fee and Interest Interest on the understated or unpaid amounts due to us at the highest rate allowed by law plus cost of audit Upon demand Interest is due on any understated or unpaid amounts due to franchisor. Audit fee is payable if audit shows an understatement of at least 2% of Gross Sales for any period, or if you fail to produce records.
Delayed Approval Fee $170 per day Upon your request for additional time For Single Store Development Program only.
Delayed Development Fee $350 per day Upon your request for additional time For Multi-Store Development and Single Store Development Program only.
Dine Brands Franchisee Technology Services Support (Help Desk) $1,000 to $1,800 per year, subject to change 30 days after billing (billed annually) This service is optional but highly recommended.
Punchh and loyalty program $0 to $100 Upon demand These fees are paid indirectly through contributions to the National Advertising Fund and are required to be enabled as part of the IHOP loyalty program.
BYOD/Pay 'N' Go $0 to $100 Upon demand These fees are paid indirectly through contributions to the National Advertising Fund and are required to be enabled as part of the IHOP loyalty program.
Implementation Fees $250 to $1,500 Upon demand These fees relate to deployment and support for hardware, software and upgrades, as well as other products
Insurance Amount of unpaid premiums Upon demand Payable only if we elect to obtain coverage upon your failure to do so.
Late Fee Highest rate permitted by law or 1-1/2% per month, whichever is less Continues to accrue until paid Payable if you are late paying any amount due IHOP or an IHOP Affiliate.
National Gift Card Program Charges 15% of the redeemed portion of gift cards sold in the national program, but the amount may change Cost is recovered as part of the periodic electronic settlement process for sales and redemptions of gift cards.
On-Location Assistance Fee $0 to $16,000 30 days after billing Only if requested by you.
Renewal Fee $10,000 for General Renewal Term; Amount to be negotiated for Special Renewal Term For General Renewal Term, upon execution of new Franchise Agreement. For Special Renewal Term, if any, weekly during extended term.
Self-Supported Franchisee Technology Services Support $275-$400 per service/incident 30 days after billing If franchisee chooses to not use Dine Brands Franchisee Technology Services Support (Help Desk), these optional fees apply.
Supplier/Distributor Approval Costs of sample testing plus other actual costs, such as facility inspection 30 days after billing Payable if you want us to approve a new supplier.
Transfer Fee (Franchise Agreement) $7,500, plus $5,000 training fee per person per Restaurant 50% payable at time of notification, balance by effective date of transfer.
Transfer Fee (Multi-Store Development Agreement) $2,500 50% payable at time of notification, balance by effective date of transfer.
Food Safety Evaluation Reaudit Fee $0 to $1,280 Upon demand.
Egg Audit $0 to $500 Upon demand.
